title: fix(ui): state the real page:header mobileMaxVisible default in designer text
body:
Fixes #35840
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在 Studio 设计器和组件文档里,页面头部「手机端最多显示的按钮数」的说明,现在写对了默认值(手机记录页底栏是 2,其他头部是 1,原来写成 1)。
- 为了让设计器说明、文档与已定稿的规格说明一致,避免设计者按错误默认值配置。
- 只改文字和注释,不改任何行为;出错也只是说明文字不准,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Text only in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`:

- the designer input description of `mobileMaxVisible` (was "A positive integer, defaulting to 1") now states the unset default: 2 in a record page's bottom action bar on a phone (host Edit counted), 1 on any other header;
- the `PageHeaderActionsProps` comments for `maxVisible` / `mobileMaxVisible` (were "falls back to 3" / "falls back to 1");
- the inline/overflow comment ("default to 3 / 1").

Regenerated, not hand-edited, with `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` and `node scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs`: `sdui.manifest.json`, `content/docs/ui/components/page.mdx`, and `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` (the manifest generator re-records its own sha256 there; one line, `sha256`). One changeset. `types/ui-action.ts` and `action/auto-trigger.ts` are untouched (they describe `action:bar`, fallback still 3 / 1).

Spec text matched (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` on main, from #35660 / #35821):

- `maxVisible`: "Renderer default when unset: 1 in a record page's one-row header bar, 3 on any other header."
- `mobileMaxVisible`: "Renderer default when unset: 2 in a record page's bottom action bar on a phone, 1 on any other header."

Code agrees with the spec (read before writing): `containers.tsx` `PHONE_ACTION_BAR_BUTTONS = 2` for `face: 'bar'` (Edit takes a slot there), `?? 1` for other mobile headers, `defaultMaxVisible ?? 3` on desktop with the record one-row header passing 1.

## Tests

No behavior change, so no test change. `pnpm check:sdui-reference` exit 0 (page.mdx matches the manifest, 106 components); `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0; `pnpm check:changeset-fixed` exit 0; `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Designer description, manifest and page.mdx agree with the spec default; the generated-artefact freshness checks pass locally.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` is outside the stated file surface but is written by the same generator run (sha256 line only).
- Overlap check against #35938 (same file, other region): merges cleanly.

## Verification

Read `page.mdx` row `mobileMaxVisible`: it now reads "...when unset it is 2 in a record page's bottom action bar on a phone (counting the host's Edit) and 1 on any other header...".
